title: Bloom (YC P26) Is Hiring
content:
It's never been easier to build a product, but brand still lags behind.

Small businesses are stuck with Canva templates that look like everyone else's. Startups pay $10K–$50K for brand identity, then need designers on retainer just to deploy it.

Bloom fixes that. Paste your website URL and Bloom extracts your brand DNA — colors, typography, visual style — then generates on-brand marketing assets in seconds. Social posts, ads, mockups, logos. Assets that actually look like you, not like a template.

We launched in December 2025 and went viral — 15K signups and millions of impressions. We're backed by Guillermo Rauch (founder of Vercel), and Nebular VC, with ~$1M raised. YC P26.

Image assets are just the start. We're building the Brand OS — a system that deeply understands your brand and powers everything it touches. Video, audio, campaigns, competitive research, trend monitoring.

Two-person team (founder + founding engineer), SF-based, shipping constantly, scaling fast. Massive ownership from day one.
